title: Add-Shift sheet has no dialog semantics, unlike every sibling sheet in the same file
detail: Every other modal sheet in the app declares role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="..." on its .sheet element: the feedback sheet (line 2057, aria-label="Send feedback"), the .ics import-confirm sheet (3820, "Confirm schedule import"), the classify-imported-shift sheet (3848, "Classify imported shift"), and both swap sheets (5311/5330, "Shift swaps"). AddShiftSheet's own <div className="sheet"> at 4164 carries none of these. There is also no Escape-key handler anywhere for this sheet (the only keydown listener in the whole app is the account menu's, lines 1966-1968) or focus management on open/close.
failure: A screen-reader user who opens 'Add a shift' from a calendar day gets no announcement that a dialog named 'Add a shift' just opened, and the assistive-tech virtual cursor is free to wander into the calendar/dashboard behind the scrim while it is nominally modal — the exact opposite of what happens one sheet over (Import/Classify/Feedback/Swaps) for the identical visual pattern. The same user also has no keyboard way to dismiss it (Escape does nothing here, though it works for the account menu).
fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Add a shift" to the .sheet div at line 4164, matching the existing pattern, and give it the same document keydown Escape->dismiss() handling already implemented for the account menu (1966-1968).
